posts.title: Meditative Dreams Will be Released on 2/13!
posts.description: Hi everyone! I’m excited to announce that my album Meditative Dreams will be released next month on February 13th! It’s been a long time in the making and I’m excited to make my first debut as an artist! posts.title: Why I Made Meditative Dreams
posts.description: Meditative Dreams started in a very simple, very personal way. At the time, someone I cared about was having an anxiety attack. I didn’t set out to make an album, I just recorded an acappella version of a track that eventually became “Calming.” It was the first thing that came out naturally. posts.title: How the Album Was Made
posts.description: From a production standpoint, this was all new territory for me. Most of the album was created using gear from Teenage Engineering, primarily the OP-XY and the TX-6. I used Cubasis 3 on the iPad for polishing and arrangement, and I went back and forth between WaveEditor and Caustic for the final mastering touches on Android.
